limitations: Administrative censoring independent conditional on workload is assumed.
Synthetic data do not validate the Weibull family or extrapolation.
Finite-bound/refinement checks are numerical evidence, not a proof of all omitted mass.
Weighted-node interval endpoints are less smooth than integrated means.
